x-customer-onboarding.finality: Finalized Base receipt, canonical block, direct native USDC EIP-3009 call and matching authorization/transfer logs
x-customer-onboarding.recovery: Recover the original intent. Never replace a submitted authorization. Recover lost keys by wallet authentication and replacement.

x-prepaid-availability.candidate_packages: Immutable package IDs and exact terms are listed at /v2/prepaid/plans; inspect its independent public signup/purchasing flags. No automatic wallet connection or funding.
